name: glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: GSK3B encodes glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta. Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and protein kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
